summary: Iteration 291 — Admin UX for Verification Status Testing Complete. All backend API endpoints working correctly. All frontend UI elements present and functional.

minor.issue: Returns 200 for admin user (who has email_verified=null instead of true). The check `if target.get('email_verified')` is falsy for null. This is a minor edge case since admin users are typically not self-registered.

critical_code_review_comments: FILTER pending_verification: GET /api/admin/users?status=pending_verification correctly filters self_registered=true + email_verified!=true + status not in [locked_unverified, inactive]
FILTER locked_unverified: GET /api/admin/users?status=locked_unverified correctly filters status='locked_unverified'
FILTER active: GET /api/admin/users?status=active works as before (no regression)
RESEND-VERIFICATION: POST /api/admin/users/{id}/resend-verification correctly resets created_at (grace timer), unlocks locked_unverified users, and invalidates user cache
FRONTEND STATUS DROPDOWN: Extended with 'Verifizierung läuft' and 'Gesperrt (unverifiziert)' options
FRONTEND BADGES: verify-pending badge shows 'Verifizierung läuft' with remaining hours (e.g., '24h'), verify-locked badge shows 'Gesperrt'
FRONTEND RESEND BUTTON: Mail icon button visible for both pending and locked users, triggers API + shows success toast + refetches user list
FRONTEND REGRESSION: Verified users (admin) do NOT show badges or resend button
seed_data_creation: Created test users via /api/auth/register with prefix test_iter291_*, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 291 Admin UX for Verification Status fully tested. Key findings: (1) GET /api/admin/users supports new status filters 'pending_verification' and 'locked_unverified', (2) POST /api/admin/users/{id}/resend-verification resets grace timer and unlocks locked users, (3) Frontend AdminUserRow.js shows [data-testid='verify-pending-{user_id}'] badge with remaining hours and [data-testid='verify-locked-{user_id}'] badge, (4) Both states show [data-testid='resend-verification-{user_id}'] mail button, (5) Status filter dropdown has new options. Note: Rate limiting on /api/auth/register (5 per minute) may affect automated tests - use sleep or retry logic.
